observations: Two retail boxes for 'Vicorrect Posture Corrector' are shown.
The boxes feature diagrams of spinal alignment and list benefits like pain relief and back support.
Regulatory symbols including FDA, CE, and REACH are printed at the bottom of the boxes.
The boxes are closed; the actual posture corrector devices are not visible.
The left box appears slightly larger or is positioned closer to the camera than the right one.

claims.evidence: The brand and product name are clearly printed on the boxes in photo 0.
The product is inside the packaging and its adjustability cannot be confirmed from the exterior.
The packaging shown does not explicitly state 'for Women and Men' on the visible face.

risks.risk: The item may be used, stretched out, or have failing velcro/fasteners.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the straps, stitching, and velcro surfaces.

risks.risk: The size (e.g., S, M, L, XL) is not specified, which affects fit and resale value.
risks.proof: A photo of the size label on the box or the tag on the item.
risks.if_unproven: as the least common or least desirable size

risks.risk: It is unclear if the offer is for one unit or both units shown.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation of the quantity included in the price.

proof_requests: Photo of the posture corrector outside the box to verify condition.
Photo of the size label on the box or the item's internal tag.
Clarification on whether the price is for one or both boxes.
response.reason: The product is clearly identified by brand and model on the packaging. It can be priced at its worst-case value (single unit, used/damaged condition) until further proof is provided.
